sources.title: Mike Vrabel addresses A.J. Brown rumors + Matthew Stafford gets paid! (ft. Justin Simmons)
sources.description: On the final episode of Inside Coverage, Andrew Siciliano, Charles Robinson, Jori Epstein and Frank Schwab break down Mike Vrabel's comments on adding A.J. Brown to the Pats' WR room, Matthew Stafford's contract extension and more. Plus, Justin Simmons joins!
